definitions.submitted_without_test: PRIMARY total (ship rule, D73.5) = observed rows (successful root submit with no prior root run_command matching \bpytest\b|-m\s+unittest\b|\btox\b) PLUS every submit_unverifiable row without a root test run before its earliest candidate boundary; submitted_without_test_observed = observed rows only, no-success rows excluded there and counted in count_no_successful_submit_observed
definitions.count_no_successful_submit: PRIMARY total (D73.5) = verifiable rows with no successful submit PLUS unverifiable rows whose patch_submitted is not True; *_observed = rows with no observed successful submit

definitions.success: first root harness patch_size response (builtin), or gate-authored inner harness patch_size response attributed to its enclosing root submit; acknowledgement not required
definitions.submit_unverifiable: inner/builtin success vs explicit patch_submitted mismatch, or flag unavailable; missing flag derived from harness response only, not acknowledgement; rows counted and listed

definitions.gate_llm_limit: gate-authored limit evidence, or an unacknowledged enclosing gate with the runner turns-budget error; inferred from saved evidence
definitions.gate_detection: selected_bundle v010 = gate, v011 = builtin; unidentified -> gate request/reply/child events; otherwise builtin layout and gate counts n/a
definitions.untracked_only: D72.2: canonical SUBMITTED reply and nonempty scored patch with all sections declaring new file mode; absent scored-patch evidence reported separately
definitions.primary: resolved is True, including H rows; paired by exact registered instance_id set
definitions.sign_test: exact two-sided Binomial(n discordants, p=0.5), doubled smaller tail capped at 1; no discordants -> 1
definitions.h_rows: governing d4cdf0f0 h is not None; H>=5 invalid without exemptions; a208a023 alongside
definitions.sensitivity: resolved over each arm non-H rows; denominator stated separately
definitions.known_diag: count of truthy governing classifier known_diag; null if unavailable

definitions.safety: arm3 test_files_edited and stray_files zero rows; total wall p90 <=1.10*base; empty and submitted_without_test <=base+3; missing evidence fails
definitions.thinking: thinking_bound.task: root author swe_baseline_agent, type thinking, nonempty content; blocks/chars per task and tasks>0
definitions.arm3smoke: first two registered ids exactly; i each >=1 thinking block and sum>=5; ii timing; iii vLLM startup, verification verdict, zero H, ZIP/CONTENT event proof and per-push TRANSPORT/header identity
definitions.aggregation: exact registered 33-id union; earliest supplied dir wins; duplicate attempts listed; within-dir duplicates fail inventory; identity-rejected runs only in uncounted_sensitivity
definitions.calls: timing llm_turns/tool_calls.total if present; otherwise trace root usage-bearing turns/root tool calls; linear percentiles from plan007.pct
definitions.descriptive: per repo uses timing repo, fallback id prefix before __; unscreened excludes 004-gpu-retime ids; context overflow unavailable in plan007
definitions.env_drift: header environment values, null if absent; setup/verification wall p50/p90 from timing; differences reported only
definitions.kernel_code: header kernel_code and agent/verification path hashes when present; differing values void pairing
definitions.decision: INVALID for voided pairing, identity mismatch, invalid/unruled base (arm2 base needs ruled SHIP-ELIGIBLE), unbound/failed smoke or H>=5; on ahead p<0.2 adopts only with timeout/timing/all safety; otherwise veto; off>=on KEEP-OFF; else NO-DIFFERENCE
